about_the_game:
No Other Alchemists Here is a simulation strategy game where you manage a digital world. As you uncover new elements and evolve your paradise, more challenging foes will appear to test your knowledge of alchemy and strategy.

Features

  • 100+ elements to discover

  • Challenging enemies

  • Turn-based Time Management gameplay 

Gameplay

Create basic elements and combine them to discover advanced ones. As more work is accomplished, your simulation will level up, granting access to stats that will improve your ability to manage the simulation. Discovering each element is only part of the challenge, as they may also react to one another and create surprising effects.

As time progresses, errors will start to apply extra stress on your simulation. You must use your tools and elements to conquer them and maintain your world.

Story

A burgeoning tech giant has started developing a new virtual reality environment for the world to explore. After a stranger gifts you a development build of this world, you begin to suspect that there's more to this reality than what the public thinks.
